          Coffee Marble: race to decide who buys coffee

          Coffee Marble is a free marble racing game for deciding who buys coffee at lunch or a get-together. Choose player names and a map, then watch the marbles race through obstacles to the finish. Play right in your desktop or mobile browser, with no sign-up or installation.

          How do I set names and marble counts?

          Paste names separated by line breaks, commas or tabs, including lists from spreadsheets. Write 'Alex * 5' to give one player multiple marbles. Race with 2–1,000 marbles in total.

          Can I choose a winning place other than last?

          Choose last place, first place or a custom place in player settings. Places follow the actual finish order, and the owner in your chosen place buys the coffee. In Ability Battle, every marble gets an automatic ability.

          Can I move the camera on mobile?

          Drag with one finger to pan and pinch with two fingers to zoom. On desktop, use mouse dragging and the scroll wheel. Tap or drag the minimap to view a section, and use speed controls or pause to watch at your own pace.
